newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Dollar buying revives Hungarian forex market.
newsitem.headline: Dollar buying revives Hungarian forex market.

text.p: The Hungarian forint ended weaker against the dollar as the dollar was advancing against the mark and also ended easier against the central bank's basket on the back of strong demand by one bank, dealers said.
The forint finished at 186.10/15 to the dollar, compared to 185.55/60 at opening, in active trading.
At the close it was some 20 pips weaker than the central bank's resistance level, having widened a five pip gap at opening, but having narrowed a 25-pip gap in the afternoon, dealers said.
"One bank must have had bought (dollars), making a lack of currency on the market and this drove prices up," said Robert Szucs of Inter-Europa Bank. "Others followed it in buyings."
The NBH's floating intervention band is 4.5 percent wide. The forint floats against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
